title: Even More Iron Trapdoors
body:
## Not sure why it wasn't included, but it's here now!

This Datapack changes the Iron Trapdoor recipe to match more to what Vanilla Tweaks' "More Trapdoors" Datapack does. However, instead of **_12_**, it gives **_8_**, as the recipe only calls for 4 iron, rather than 6 like every other trapdoor in the game (rlly mojang).


No I will not make one that outputs 12.


### This pack will only be updated periodically, not _every_ Minecraft update.
